content: AGENTS.md: open spec formalized Aug 2025 (OpenAI with Google, Cursor, Factory), donated to Linux Foundation Agentic AI Foundation Dec 2025. 60k+ OSS repos have one by early 2026; 20+ AI coding tools support it. Context-file survey of 4768 files: CLAUDE.md 34.4%, AGENTS.md 31.6%, copilot-instructions.md 29.2%. Guidance: keep it minimal - if a constraint can be expressed elsewhere (linter, CI, config), it must not live in AGENTS.md. Related research on config smells (arXiv 2606.15828) and instruction adherence (arXiv 2605.10039).
